rca of the issue: Original AxiosError Network Error was caused by cross-origin API calls: when the user browsed via the alias host (subject-creator.preview.emergentagent.com), the Axios client used REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (7858e35c...) as the API base, generating cross-origin requests that the edge proxy rejected via CORS (Origin header rewritten). Mitigation in frontend/src/lib/api.js selects window.location.origin as BACKEND_URL whenever the browser host is non-local and differs from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, guaranteeing same-origin XHR and WebSocket. Verified: 0 console errors and 0 unhandled promise rejections on demo-login, chat WS connect (WS same-origin, shows 'En línea'), and Google callback flows on the alias host.
